summary: Two panes side by side with a bar between them that the user drags, or moves with the arrow keys, to give one more room.

value.description: The share of the room the first pane takes, from 0 to 100.

min.description: The least share the first pane may take.

max.description: The most share the first pane may take.

orientation.description: vertical stacks the panes, with the bar lying between them.

root.note: A grid of the first pane, the bar and the second pane.

bar.note: The bar the user moves. The recipe places it between the panes.

keys.ArrowLeft, ArrowRight: In a horizontal splitter: move the bar one step.
keys.ArrowUp, ArrowDown: In a vertical splitter: move the bar one step.
keys.Home, End: Give the first pane its least or its most.
keys.Enter: Collapses the first pane, or brings it back to where it was.

events.input: Dispatched while the user moves the bar.
events.change: Dispatched when the user has finished.

notYet: A share that is not a whole number, or outside its limits, is laid out only once the element is defined.
